preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 1000, inclusive.
The number of rooms in each test case is between 2 and 300000, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: s consists of '<', '>', and '-' characters only
preconditions.description: The string s represents the states of the conveyor belts, where '<' means anticlockwise, '>' means clockwise, and '-' means off.

postconditions.description: The number of returnable rooms is less than or equal to the number of rooms in the test case.
The number of returnable rooms is non-negative.

postconditions.expression: output == sum(1 for _ in filter(lambda s: all(s[i] != '-' for i in range(len(s))), test_cases))
postconditions.description: The output is the sum of the number of returnable rooms for each test case.

invariants.expression: all(s[i] in '<>-' for i in range(n))
invariants.description: Each character in the string s is one of '<', '>', or '-'.
